title: P2RLN Native Component Instance Profile
description: Declares thin data-only component instances resolved against trusted host-installed Component Registry implementations.
rules: The representation media type MUST be application/vnd.p2rln.component+json.
The package instance MUST identify componentVersion, dataVersion and runtimeContractVersion independently.
Component implementation code, migrations and privileged capability grants MUST come from the trusted host, not from automatic package JavaScript execution.
Runtime data migration MUST be deterministic with respect to the source data and registered migration path and MUST NOT mutate the package bytes.
Unknown or incompatible component implementations MUST fail explicitly or use another Core representation; they MUST NOT be silently reinterpreted.
